sections.heading: Headline — the start-boost A/B is DONE, and the trade is adverse

fields.label: (b) improves
fields.value: 13 → 6 failing bands. Car 1 5→4, car 2 4→2, car 3 4→0 (passes outright). c1_median 52.5/38.0/49.0 → 0.0 and abs_steer_median 52.5/57.5/49.0 → 6.0/21.0/9.0, in band on all three cars. STILL NOT MET on 2 of 3 cars.

fields.label: ...but car 1 gains TWO new failures
fields.value: accel_distinct and brake_distinct: in arm B car 1 takes only c4=255 and only c5=0 over the window, against the original's c4 in {0,64,255} (255 on 63.6%) and c5 in {0,255} (255 on 21.4%). Reported rather than netted out of the count.

fields.label: (e) regresses 6/6
fields.value: −46% to −90%. launch 1426.4/2053.0/2055.2 → 200.5 on every car, against the ORIGINAL's own 1425.7/2052.5/2055.0. The original demonstrably HAS a launch and arm A reproduces it to 0.05%, so removing the seed removes the port's only reproduction of a real original behaviour.

fields.label: The seed is worth HALF the over-speed
fields.value: Window speed vs the original +41/+40/+34% → +31/+21/+15% (median call index 109.5 on both sides). A sustained +15..31% SURVIVES the knob and is a separate, unidentified carrier.

fields.label: Knob proved live in flight
fields.value: re/tools/sa_boostwatch.py (ReadProcessMemory, no injection, no Frida): slots 1..3 read g_startBoosted 0→1 with +0xbf8 == 1 and +0xbf4 decaying 1100/900/700/500/300/100 (the −200/frame law) in arm A, never seeded in arm B. Slot 0 never seeded in either arm. One read site in the whole port: VehiclePhysicsRun.cpp:703.

fields.label: One gate REPLACED, stated prominently
fields.value: The pre-registered base self-check record[v]+0x000 == v is FALSE in the port (g_records is a port-local mirror memset to 0) and voided the first witness run. Replaced by three stronger legs: bool-domain check on g_startBoosted, agreement of the witness's +0x9e4 with the same run's stepdump rec_9e4, and the arm A vs arm B contrast itself.

sections.heading: THE OPEN USER DECISION — nothing should be ported until it is made

fields.label: 1. Keep the seed (status quo)
fields.value: (e) MET 3/3, (b) 13 failing bands. The AI third stays blocked on (b).

fields.label: 2. Remove the seed
fields.value: (b) 6 failing bands with car 3 passing outright, (e) fails 6/6 by 46-90%. Trades a MET criterion for a still-NOT-MET one.

fields.label: 3. Keep it, attack the residual over-speed
fields.value: Closing the surviving +15..31% would move car 1's c1_distinct 80→50 and steer_distinct 86→61 INTO band (ai_band_sim.py, validation 220/220 = 1.000 on all three cars). The only route that does not trade one criterion against the other. Not costed yet.

fields.label: Standing question, still undecided
fields.value: (b)'s c0_distinct / c1_distinct / steer_distinct count which side of a hard discontinuity a 1-2 deg oscillation lands on, so a faithful port can fail them. Whether to re-specify (b) on a band-invariant statistic is a ROADMAP decision. No band was moved.

sections.heading: What is LEFT of criterion (b) — U-9185, three named holes

fields.label: (a) the elimination confound
fields.value: With the seed ON the player is eliminated at rt = 1.8667 s, INSIDE the scored window (race_[0].alive 0 vs 1, TrackRenderer.cpp:4664). round_mode_ is true and the AI tick loop at AiStandalone.cpp:1708 runs v = 0..3 gated on car_alive, so VehicleStep(0) runs in arm B and not in arm A. Until that is controlled no arm A vs arm B delta is single-cause. CHEAPEST NEXT MOVE.

fields.label: (b) which heading candidate
fields.value: At matched position the body heading is still the larger median share on all three cars in both arms, and on car 2 it GROWS 0.9085 → 1.6059 deg when the seed is removed. Two separable candidates: the physics' own io.yaw (TrackRenderer.cpp:3327) and the (cos, sin) reconstruction at :3729. Car 2 is the car to probe.

fields.label: (c) the surviving over-speed
fields.value: +15..31% is NOT the seed. Carrier unidentified.

fields.label: Two different per-car carriers
fields.value: ai_band_sim.py counterfactuals on arm B: car 1's residual is SPEED (ORIG speed closes c1_distinct 80→50, steer_distinct 86→61, lifts c0_distinct 7→12 against a floor of 13); car 2's residual is ERR (ORIG speed makes car 2 worse on every statistic).
